name: Alebrijes
source:
Alebrijes is a visual novel with four protagonists, whose lives were forever altered by a horrible tragedy. They all tried to cope with their losses and move on.

Now, eight years later, a new tragedy brings them back to their childhood town. But will this event bring them together or break them apart? When fate comes calling, will they stand together or fight alone?

Only you can decide!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/340693452/alebrijes-a-detective-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《阿莱布里赫斯》是一部有四位主人公的视觉小说，他们的人生都因一场可怕悲剧永远改变。四人努力面对失去的一切，继续生活。

八年后，新的悲剧让他们回到童年小镇。但这起事件会让他们重新走到一起，还是让彼此彻底决裂？当命运敲门，他们会并肩作战，还是独自迎战？

只有你能决定！

[来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/340693452/alebrijes-a-detective-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter项目页面[/url]]
